description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and profile retrieval in a FastAPI application. It handles request validation, delegates core logic to services, manages error handling, and documents API endpoints.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration by validating input, calling the authentication service to create a new user, and returning user details or raising HTTP exceptions on errors.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user login, authenticates credentials via the auth service, and returns a JWT token or raises errors.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile information based on the provided Bearer token.
